name: Alpinhotel Lizumer Bergheim
beschreibung: The Alpinhotel Lizumer Bergheim sits at an altitude of 1,650 meters in the Lizum Valley in the Tux Alps. It offers rooms with balconies providing scenic views of the surrounding mountains. Amenities include a wellness area featuring a Finnish sauna and steam bath, alongside a restaurant serving regional specialties. The property serves as a prime starting point for hiking and ski touring, bordering directly on the Glungezer ski area. In winter, an in-house rental service for ski and touring gear is readily available. For guided explorations, route suggestions and detailed maps are provided on site.
